pages.text: Fire charges can be launched by right-clicking with one in the main hand. The inherited implementation activates this interaction when the Shoot Fireballs gene is absent or disabled; this port preserves that existing behavior.

pages.text: $(bold)Mob sources$()$(br)Blaze, Ghast.$(br2)Collect their organic matter, then analyze, extract, decode, and infuse the gene. Server configuration can disable individual genes.
